title: Susan Saint James, star of McMillan & Wife and Kate & Allie, has died at 80
dek: The Emmy-winning actress led two long-running American series. Her death on 26 October 2026 was announced the next day.
what: Susan Saint James, the actress known for "McMillan & Wife" and "Kate & Allie," died on Monday, 26 October 2026, at 80. Variety and The Hollywood Reporter reported it on 27 October.
ABC7 New York reports that People magazine announced the death, citing a representative for the actress, and that the cause was pancreatic cancer.

ABC7 says she won an Emmy for "The Name of the Game" in 1969, was nominated three times for "McMillan & Wife" (1971 to 1976) and twice for "Kate & Allie" (1984 to 1989). It lists her husband, Dick Ebersol, among her survivors.
why: Both series ran for years on network television, and many readers grew up with them. Entertainment trade outlets posted within minutes of one another, and fans passed the news along.
next: A memorial or funeral announcement from her family or representative, if one is made.
